dedupe_keys.name: ls 500 global 500 m cropland suitability rainfed irrigated and slope limited

description: LS-500 is a global cropland suitability dataset at 500 m (18 arc-seconds), built from new cropland extent data and including topographic effects from a recent digital elevation model. The Zenodo record says it also gives suitability with and without irrigation, meaning suitability under natural conditions, and the three archives are labelled original, slope and irrigation, with a README. It was published in April 2021 by Yuki Ishikawa and Dai Yamazaki of the Institute of Industrial Science, The University of Tokyo, under the CC BY 4.0 licence, free to download as three zips of about 5.7 GB. Coverage is global. Caveats: suitability is modelled potential, not actual cropland, and the file format and climate period are not stated on the page read. For simulation it gives where cropland could expand or relocate under climate adaptation, for land allocation and food supply scenarios. Related catalogue records include the global dataset of areas under cropland expansion pressure and the FAO cropland agreement map.
